fundamental.summary: CCL shows no insider buying conviction, no institutional accumulation signals, zero government contracts, no lobbying activity, minimal retail interest, and elevated earnings risk in 74 days.

risk.summary: Extreme VIX crisis regime (350.56), flat yield curve, rising dollar, and Consumer Discretionary sector vulnerability create severely unfavourable macro conditions for CCL despite 74-day earnings buffer.

debate.key_bull_argument: Hull flip, force index cross-up, and Parabolic SAR bullish signals combined with extreme fear sentiment (35/100) and price near support (8.8226) create a contrarian entry opportunity for mean reversion.
debate.key_bear_argument: Fundamental score of 2, macro crisis regime (VIX 350.56), price below all key moving averages (EMA-21/50, SMA-50/200), Ichimoku below cloud, no insider conviction, and high earnings risk in 74 days create overwhelming headwinds that outweigh short-term technical bounces.
